description: The profile lock protocol of spec 8.4. Every implementation that shares a profile must follow it.

ownerFields.startedAt: string: ISO 8601 UTC time the lock was acquired
ownerFields.token: string: 32 lowercase hex characters, random per acquisition

acquire: mkdir {lockDir} (mode 0700); the holder then writes {ownerFile} atomically (temp file in the lock directory, fsync, rename; mode 0600)
staleReference: mtime of ownerFile; when ownerFile is missing, mtime of the lock directory
staleRemoval: rename the lock directory to a unique sibling name, check that the moved directory is the one observed stale (same directory, same owner, still stale), then delete it; otherwise put it back if the lock path is still free
onTimeout: never run the guarded operation (never refresh, never sign)
release: only when ownerFile still holds this holder's token: rename away, check the token again, delete
